propositions: Pandoc 3.6.1 escapes punctuation inside code spans, deletes HTML comments, and corrupts arrow delimiters, requiring post-render code-preservation checks and explicit phase-1 locking of protected blocks.
Two-phase left-to-right lexer locks complete `{noformat}` spans, HTML comments, backtick/tilde fences, and four-space-indented blocks before segmentation and classification.

Classifier splits wiki markup into unambiguous forms (`{{…}}`, `[a|b]`, `{color:}`) that settle a unit alone, and ambiguous forms (`*x*`, `_x_`) that settle only with no CommonMark-only markers, eliminating the 2-cycle oscillation.
A deterministic scrubbed 178-body corpus (29 code-arrow, 29 table, 120 prose) pins per-stratum cardinality and measures rendering fidelity at body ratio >=0.90 and character ratio >=0.95.

Missing pypandoc returns the body unchanged with a content-free `wiki_render_fallback` event (reason: `pandoc_absent`); conversion or preservation failure returns the unit unchanged with reason `conversion_failure` or `preservation_failure`.
The `wiki` extra pins `pypandoc-binary==1.15` and is installed jointly with other extras; real binary probes confirm pandoc 3.6.1 and suppress monkeypatch shapes.
